note: [lib, name, category, keywords, best for, usage, accessible name, (phosphor weight)]. Own wording. Names must exist in icons-meta.json.
rows: hamburger menu toggle drawer burger three lines open navigation
Button that opens the site menu on a phone
Pair with a visible 'Menu' word where space allows; swap to X when the drawer is open.
Button named 'Menu' with aria-expanded set to true or false
back previous return go back step
Back link or button, earlier step in a form
Place before the label, not after; mirror it in right-to-left layouts.
next forward continue proceed call to action
Primary link or button that moves on, next step
Put after the label in left-to-right text; nudge it 2px on hover, not more.
Decorative when the label says 'Continue'; otherwise aria-label 'Next'
back to top scroll up jump top return top
Long pages: button that returns to the top
Show it after roughly two screens of scroll; keep it clear of cookie banners and chat bubbles.
dropdown disclosure accordion expand select caret open
Accordions, selects and menus that open downward
Rotate 180 degrees when open and expose the state on the button.
list row go detail disclosure breadcrumb separator more
Rows that lead to a detail page, breadcrumb separators
Right edge of a tappable row; in breadcrumbs mark it aria-hidden.
Decorative; the row text is the name
home homepage start main page house
Home link in a header or bottom bar
In a bottom bar always include a text label under it.
close dismiss cancel remove clear exit shut
Close button on dialogs, banners and drawers
Give it a 44px square target even if the glyph is 20px.
Button named 'Close' plus what it closes, e.g. 'Close menu'
external link new tab outside site opens elsewhere
Links that leave the site or open a new tab
Add after link text and say so in text for screen readers.
Link text plus visually hidden '(opens in a new tab)'
more overflow options kebab actions three dots menu
Keep to one overflow per row; important actions stay visible.
sidebar toggle collapse drawer side panel rail
Showing or hiding a side navigation
Remember the choice between visits for dashboard users.
directions wayfinding signpost route which way sign guide
Good beside a list of ways to reach a venue.
Decorative beside the heading 'How to find us'
adjust settings controls tune preferences sliders options
Opening a panel of adjustable options
Choose it over a funnel when the panel holds more than filtering.
sign in log in login enter account access
Sign in link for returning users
Pair with the word 'Sign in'; icon alone is not enough on a first visit.
sign out log out leave exit session logout
Keep it away from frequent actions to avoid mis-taps.
person profile account me user avatar placeholder
Account menu, profile link, default avatar
Use circle-user when the avatar sits in a circle.
Link named 'Account' or the person's name
team people group staff customers members about us
Team pages, customer counts, group settings
Prefer real staff photos on About pages and keep this for admin screens.
invite add person register sign up new member create account
Label it 'Invite' or 'Create account' in text.
id card licence membership badge pass identity registration number
Membership cards, ID checks, registration numbers
Good for showing a trade body or licence number in the footer.
settings preferences gear cog configure options admin
Do not use for every wrench-like action; it means preferences.
